outcome: composite of neonatal morbidity (5-minute Apgar < 7, neonatal intensive care unit admission, neonatal mechanical ventilation > 6 hours, neonatal seizure, and/or neonatal transport to a higher level of care)
cohort: The study included 27,276 twin deliveries from U.S. Vital Statistics Natality birth certificate registry data (2012-2014) where twin A was vertex and delivered vaginally at 36 to 40 weeks gestation.
finding: Twin birthweight discordance greater than 20% was associated with increased odds of adverse neonatal outcomes, with higher discordance degrees correlating with progressively higher odds.
